title: Custom eggless cake pickup until 10pm for Rosehill and Camellia families
summary:
Rosehill and Camellia don't have their own bakery. Harris Park does — open until 10pm, seven days.

That's not a footnote. It's the difference between finishing a 9-to-5 in Camellia and finding every cake shop already shut, or driving five minutes to Wigram Street and walking out with what you ordered.

100% eggless. Six sizes, 15 flavours, buttercream, fondant or ganache. 48 hours minimum notice — that's what fresh baking actually takes, not a same-day promise we can't keep.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725. We speak Hindi and Gujarati too.
